title: Ship-status names change reopen for an accepted or archived change only when its own accepted evidence is stale and readable
description: ship-status names change reopen for an accepted or archived change only when its own accepted evidence is stale and readable
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cmd-change-033 lets the product-tip stage advertise only a command whose state guard admits the change; change reopen refuses accepted evidence that is current (unrelated project drift) and evidence it cannot load, so naming it there advertised a refused command (#922)
acceptance_criteria: an archived change whose own accepted evidence is current is not told to reopen after an unrelated committed edit, and its product stage is done; an archived change whose verification.json cannot be read is told to restore it, not to reopen; an accepted or archived change with stale accepted evidence is still told to reopen
